resources.string: Manage the company account in a simple order: open the current profile, join an existing company when invited, or invite a colleague when you manage the company.
1. Company profile and license\nView or manage the current company account
2. Join with an invitation\nUse an invitation received from a company administrator
3. Invite a colleague\nCreate access for another person in the company
Use the first part for normal connection and synchronization. Paths, backup codes, and other technical fields remain hidden under Advanced settings.
1. Connection and sign-in
Enable server synchronization, enter the server address and access token, then test the connection.
2. Notes waiting to be synchronized
The app keeps unsent notes locally. Check their status here and retry after the connection is restored.
3. Advanced server details
Open only when changing endpoint paths or transferring server settings with a four-digit backup code.
First choose where local notes are stored, then create or restore a complete backup when needed.
1. Where notes are stored
Storage access is controlled from Permissions and readiness. The current status is shown below.
2. Backup and restore
Create a file before reinstalling or changing phones. Restore imports saved settings and local data from a selected backup.
Start with text size, then choose the app language. Version information is shown last. Editing individual translations is an advanced feature.
1. Text size
Normal is the default. Larger options increase text throughout the app.
2. App language
This changes only Relationship Manager; the phone language is not changed.
3. Advanced: edit individual translations
Use only when a specific label needs custom wording. Changes apply inside this app and can be reset for the selected language.
4. App version
These tools are for diagnostics and development checks. They do not need to be changed for normal daily use.
